qc_policy: qc bits 0-3 = gear (0 unknown; 1 manta net; 2 neuston net (incl. AVANI); 3 large ('mega') net; 4 pump / seawater intake; 5 grab / bottle / bucket / sampler; 6 aircraft survey line; 7 other net (plankton, bongo, ring, seston, ovoid); 8 cleanup-system catch (System 002)); bit 4 (16): time of day not given, placed at 12:00 UTC; bit 5 (32): day not given, placed mid-month; bit 6 (64): EMODnet sample whose total includes shape-only micro-litter lines (no polymer type), counted as plastic. Values outside the physical bounds -> NaN, counted. A row with no concentration is dropped.
title: Floating plastic at the sea surface: one row per net tow, water sample or aircraft survey line (The Ocean Cleanup, NOAA NCEI, EMODnet), de-duplicated across producers
verified: 2026-10-11 from the sandbox: both figshare items (API listings, the 2024 description that defines every column, the 2018 traps), the NCEI Hub CSV (29,076 rows, 16,988 ocean water, every time of day 05:00 or 06:00 AM), the data files of every NCEI accession the surface-net rows cite (headers read for areal columns), the EMODnet v2026 zip (32,067 lines, 3,385 samples) and the NVS H01/H05/P01 vocabulary definitions
